Thursday last week I awoke with a medical problem. Initially I sought the advice of 3 pharmacists, 2 didn’t know what it was, 1 thought a cold sore. The following day the problem had not resolved and I saw a member of the urgent care team - a paramedic. Professional, friendly but she didn’t know what the problem was. She treated me for shingles and prescribed medication. Over the weekend the problem hadn’t resolved or eased. I knew there was no point seeing a paramedic again so did online request for Dr’s appointment. Got a txt. Your symptoms need to be seen today ring the surgery.
